name: 糖枫
region: 东北部、五大湖与阿巴拉契亚山脉
leaf: 五裂叶；金黄、橙色至红色
note: 糖枫的秋色在同一棵树上也会出现黄、橙、红的变化。
descriptionEn: Five-lobed leaves turn gold, orange and red. A single sugar maple can display all three colors.
regionEn: Northeastern U.S., the Great Lakes and the Appalachian Mountains.

name: 红枫
note: 秋色常较早出现；不同个体和栽培品种颜色不一。
descriptionEn: Three- to five-lobed leaves turn vivid red or orange-red. Color often arrives early and varies between individuals and cultivars.
regionEn: Eastern North America, from wetlands to mountain forests.

name: 纸皮桦
region: 美国北部、阿拉斯加及高海拔地区
note: 金黄色秋叶与白色纸状树皮形成鲜明对比。
descriptionEn: Oval, serrated leaves turn bright gold, contrasting with the white, papery bark.
regionEn: Northern U.S., Alaska and higher elevations.

name: 颤杨
region: 落基山脉、美国北部和阿拉斯加
note: 同一克隆群落可能同步变色，形成金色林片。
descriptionEn: Nearly round leaves usually turn gold. Trees within one clonal colony may change together, creating broad golden groves.
regionEn: The Rocky Mountains, northern U.S. and Alaska.

name: 北美红栎
note: 变色往往晚于桦树与枫树，颜色也较沉稳。
descriptionEn: Pointed lobes take on brick-red and russet tones, often later than birches and maples.

name: 北美枫香
note: 常在同一树冠同时呈现多种秋色。
descriptionEn: Star-shaped, five-lobed leaves turn yellow, orange, red and purple, often together in one crown.

name: 紫树
leaf: 椭圆形光亮叶；猩红至紫红
note: 较早变色的东部树种之一，红色秋叶鲜明。
descriptionEn: Glossy, oval leaves turn scarlet to purple-red. This is one of the eastern species that often colors early.

name: 北美鹅掌楸
note: 常见于东部湿润肥沃的林地，秋叶主要呈黄色。
descriptionEn: Four-lobed leaves with a squared-off tip turn gold. The species commonly grows on moist, fertile forest sites.

name: 美洲山毛榉
leaf: 椭圆锯齿叶；金黄至铜褐
note: 部分枯叶会在幼树枝上保留到冬季。
descriptionEn: Oval, serrated leaves turn gold to copper-brown. Some dried leaves remain on young trees into winter.
regionEn: Mature broadleaf forests of the eastern U.S.

name: 大叶枫
region: 太平洋西岸，从华盛顿州至加利福尼亚
leaf: 大型掌状裂叶；黄色、金黄
note: 西海岸代表性枫树，秋色主要为金黄。
descriptionEn: Large, palmately lobed leaves turn yellow and gold. A characteristic maple of the Pacific Coast.
regionEn: Pacific Coast, from Washington to California.
